content:
Riley: Nimbus wants a tiny POC to prove they can switch from VendorX to Redwood with minimal client changes. Key asks: API compatibility (same response shape), prompt parity for 6 templates, billing translation (VendorX 50-token rounding -> per-token), and completed security Qs incl. CMK.
Jo: We should deliver an adapter that accepts VendorX payloads and returns identical-looking responses. Add a compat flag to toggle legacy fields like choices[].logprobs (default off).
Anika: I'll run parity tests. Need their six canonical prompts and a small sample of anonymized logs for tokenization diffs. Will run deterministic (seed + top_k=1) and a baseline non-deterministic run.
Jared: I'll prototype the shim. Plan: accept X-VendorX-Session and VendorX-style body (`input`), map to Redwood fields, populate KV with last 3 messages, then call our runtime. Adapter will synthesize usage.total_tokens and finish_reason to match VendorX.
sec-bot: Note: customer-managed KMS for hosted requires security approval and workspace isolation. See internal runbook.
Riley: Timeline: Nimbus asked for a demo Thu. Can we produce a runnable demo + short report by Wed EOD?
Jo: Billing sim: VendorX bills per-request rounding up to 50 tokens. I'll run a conversion script on their sample logs to show per-token cost and p50/p95 deltas.
Anika: Parity caveat: tokenization differences can shift token counts by a few percent. Optional hack: pre-tokenize with VendorX tokenizer in shim and pass token ids when allowed. I'll document tradeoffs.
Jared: Example demo curl:
```
curl -X POST https://demo.redwood/compat/vendorx \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer demo-token" \
  -H "X-VendorX-Session: s-123" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize last quarter","max_tokens":60}'
```
Response will include choices[0].text and usage.total_tokens to help their billing UI.
Jo: Also note VendorX sometimes returns choices[].logprobs and choices[].metadata; we'll synthesize minimal metadata (model, version) and keep logprobs behind compat toggle & contract.
Anika: Latency note: shim adds ~8-15ms on cache hit for KV assembly; cache miss could add ~40ms. Will surface both numbers.
Riley: Action items: 1) Jared -> shim prototype + demo curl (Tue PM). 2) Anika -> parity diffs + doc (Wed AM). 3) Jo -> billing sim + pricing slide (Wed AM). 4) Pri -> security Q draft + CMK path (Tue noon). Ping me when artifacts land. :thumbsup:
